verdict.rationale: BVNK documents a public REST API in depth. The docs cover Hawk-signed authentication with Portal-generated API keys, concrete endpoints (POST /payment/v1/rules, POST /payment/v2/payins/simulation, Transfers v3 with mandatory idempotency), an API explorer, a sandbox mirroring production, and wallet management via Portal or API. A probe confirms a machine-readable llms.txt with complete API documentation is live. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of actually driving the API end-to-end.
